test_docstring_options: test pybind11 docstring options to verify disable function signatures and custom docstrings work correctly
test_disable_function_signatures: test that pybind11 options disable function signatures so bound functions have no docstring
test_custom_docstring: test that a custom docstring is applied to a pybind11 bound function
test_overloaded_docstrings: test that docstrings are correctly assigned to overloaded pybind11 function definitions
test_disable_user_defined_docstrings: test that pybind11 options suppress user-defined docstrings for functions and class properties
